thread:
taylor: Quick checkpoint — RC build goes out at 18:00 UTC. We need a green-sweep by 17:30. Please bump package.json to 2.4.0-rc.1 if you're cutting a release branch. Ping me if you're gating.

sam: On it. I have a branch with the v2.4 bump: refs/heads/release/v2.4-bump. Will open PR in ~10m.

maya: Heads up — changelog needs entries for feature flags + dedupe caching. @andrea can you add a short note under "Unreleased"?

andrea: Adding changelog now. Also running full CI locally: `./scripts/ci_local.sh --suite=smoke` — will report back.

ci-bot: nightly-build #1799 finished: tests 342 passed, 3 failed — failures: flaky/test_kv_cache_eviction, integration/test-cold-start, smoke/test-api-timeout.

sam: that flaky keeps popping. I pushed a sketch fix in PR #523 but it's still intermittent in CI. Can someone re-run the job with the isolated matrix? `./ci/retry.sh --job 1799 --isolated`

oliver: re-run started: https://ci.redwood-inference/internal/job/1799/console — early logs show macos-12 runners hitting timeouts on test_kv_cache_eviction. Increasing that test timeout to 90s might be the least invasive short-term fix.

maya: For the green-sweep, can we temporarily `--exclude` test_kv_cache_eviction with a `[flake]` tag in the pipeline? We should also open a ticket to triage root cause. @taylor ok with excluding for RC?

taylor: ok to exclude for the RC sweep only. Create a ticket (ENG-4381) and assign to eng-infra, leave a TODO in the PR describing the skip and link the ticket. We'll re-enable strict gating after the sweep. :thumbsup:

sam: re-run completed — all green on CI after excluding the flaky. Merging bump PR now and tagging `v2.4.0-rc.1`. Changelog PR merged as well.

taylor: Thanks team — rolling release window open. Reminder: cutoff 18:00 UTC. If anyone plans a late change, post here and include the risk note.

andrea: added ENG-4381 with initial triage notes and logs, assigned to @oliver. PR includes TODO and a note in the changelog.

oliver: I'll start debugging the macos runner timings tomorrow morning. Quick note: recording the failing run: `logs/1799/test_kv_cache_eviction/attempt-3.log` — see stack at bottom for eviction delay.

taylor: perfect. Appreciate the quick sweep — everyone who merged, please confirm any post-merge smoke checks in this thread.

sam: confirmed smoke checks done. All good on prod-preview.

maya: leaving a small follow-up playbook entry in eng-infra docs about flaky labelling for RCs.

taylor: great — closing the sweep. Good job.
